techniques.name: Spaced revision
techniques.how: Each chapter comes back for quick revision 1, 3, 7 and 14 days after you first study it, instead of being crammed once.
techniques.evidence: Rated one of only two 'high utility' study techniques in a review of 10 techniques. The best gap between revisions grows the further away the exam is.
techniques.cite: Dunlosky et al., 2013; Cepeda et al., 2008

techniques.name: Recall before you reread
techniques.how: Revision sessions start with the book closed: write down what you remember, then check and fix the gaps.
techniques.evidence: Students who tested themselves remembered 61% of a passage a week later, against 40% for students who only reread it.

techniques.name: Timed papers in the last two weeks
techniques.how: Before each exam, the plan swaps new chapters for full timed papers from the board or the exam body, marked with the official scheme.
techniques.evidence: Practice testing is the other 'high utility' technique. Rereading and highlighting were rated low utility.

techniques.name: Mixed subjects each day
techniques.how: Back-to-back sessions switch subjects, so each day mixes, for example, Maths, Science and Social Science.
techniques.evidence: Rated 'moderate utility', with the strongest results for maths problem practice.

activities.name: Science olympiads (NSEJS, NSEP, NSEC, NSEB, NSEA)
activities.when: Enrol through your school around August to September; the first round is in late November.
activities.why: The first step to the national olympiads, and good practice for JEE and NEET style thinking.

activities.name: Maths olympiad (IOQM)
activities.when: Registration usually opens mid-year; the exam is in September.
activities.why: Builds problem solving that data, engineering and finance careers value.

activities.name: INSPIRE-MANAK idea competition
activities.when: Schools nominate ideas each year, usually June to September.
activities.why: A national government programme for student ideas that solve everyday problems.

activities.name: Robotics or tinkering club
activities.when: Weekly, all year. Many schools have an Atal Tinkering Lab.
activities.why: Hands-on building is what engineering degrees and interviews look for.

activities.name: Build one small app or website
activities.when: Any time; aim to finish one project each term.
activities.why: A finished project shows more than a certificate.

activities.name: Design portfolio: a sketch a day and one redesign a month
activities.when: All year; design entrances (UCEED, NID DAT, NIFT) reward drawing practice.
activities.why: Design colleges judge sketching and observation, which only improve with regular practice.

activities.name: Debate, elocution or Model UN
activities.when: Inter-school events run mostly from July to December.
activities.why: Law, civil services and business all depend on arguing a case clearly.

activities.name: Write for the school magazine or a blog
activities.why: A body of published writing is the portfolio for journalism and media.

activities.name: NCC (National Cadet Corps)
activities.when: Join through your school's NCC unit at the start of the year.
activities.why: Builds discipline and leadership, and NCC certificates carry weight for defence careers.

activities.name: First aid course and health volunteering
activities.when: Short courses run through the year.
activities.why: A real taste of care work before committing to medicine or nursing.

activities.name: Teach or mentor younger students
activities.when: Weekly, all year, through school or a local NGO.
activities.why: Shows whether you enjoy explaining and supporting people, which teaching and psychology need.

activities.name: Run a small venture (a school fest stall or an online shop)
activities.when: Plan it around a school fest or the summer break.
activities.why: Selling something real teaches pricing, money and people faster than any book.

activities.name: Read one popular science or psychology book a month
activities.why: Builds the background that makes interviews and college essays easier.

activities.name: Shadow a professional for a day
activities.why: One day watching someone at work tells you more than any list of pros and cons.

activities.name: Keep one sport or regular exercise
activities.when: All year, including exam months (shorter sessions).
activities.why: A regular break from desk work makes long study months easier to sustain.
